This plot is small, only a quarter hectare, and it is rented land so I do not want to put too much money into it. Since it is not my main crop and I have other bigger plots to worry about, I will keep things simple. I will buy a small bag of DAP and urea from the cooperative if it arrives in time, but only a little because fertilizer is expensive and the rains have been uncertain. I will use my own saved seed, put some manure from my oxen, and my wife and children will help me with most of the work. I cannot afford to hire much labor for this small rented plot.
